scope: One live Muse question about the bundled public photo and previously recorded SAM detections. No private image, physical fit test or hosted deployment check.
question: How could I make this desk easier to work at, and what should I measure before adding another device?

result.answer: Center the external keyboard and mouse in front of the large monitor and angle the laptop to the side as a secondary screen to reduce twisting. Keep the phone and tablet out of the central mousing zone and tidy the loose cable on the left to free work space. Before adding another device, measure the open desk width and depth and compare to the new device footprint.
observations: Laptop angled on left overlaps central zone
External keyboard centered under monitor with mouse and phone below it
Tablet on right edge and small plant near keyboard
result.limitation: A single top-down photo cannot confirm actual size, fit, or clearance. Measure the clear area width/depth, the new device footprint, and cable and outlet reach with a tape measure.
